units: Par. VII, 7 המְכַנֵּן … על יד על יד (Talm. ed. only once על יד) he who winds the rope (for drawing the bucket up) around his hand until a sufficient length is wound up; ואם כִּנְּנוֹ באחרונה but if he winds it after he has finished drawing; Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 4 וחזר ובנאו ed. Zuck. (Var. וכי, read: וכיננו as R. S. to Par. l. c.).—Part. pass. מְכוּנָּן a) wound around.
Makhsh. IV, 1 בחבל שהוא מכ׳ וכ׳ with the rope which is wound around the neck of the vessel.—2) nested.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> <he>מכ׳ כביצה</he> shut up in the nest like an egg, i.e. selfish; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 832">Yalk. Ps. 832</cite> <cite ref="M01358"><he>מכונה</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
